summary: Phase 149O.20J.1 -- Class-B Deployment Verifier / Model-A Environment-Lock Narrow Defect Repair: repairs exactly the 3 Blocking findings recorded (not repaired) by Phase 149O.20J, nothing else. Reproduced all three historical defects against phase-entry source before any production edit: (1) confirmed CPython's real running-interpreter site.py addpackage() source classifies .pth lines by raw-line startswith(('import ', 'import\t')) after excluding #-comment and blank lines, while the pre-repair predicate line.strip().startswith('import ') recognized only the space-delimited form; (2) confirmed _current_agent_identity's pre-repair source contained no os.getegid() reference via inspect.getsource; (3) confirmed _resolve_trusted_executable's pre-repair source called only _mode_and_group_write_access, never the ACL-including _effective_write_access. Repaired J-1 by adding _pth_line_is_executable(line) to hatp_environment_lock_verifier.py, a direct transcription of CPython's own per-line classification (comment check, blank check, then raw-line two-form executable check) -- also correcting a second, narrower divergence beyond the disclosed tab-form miss: the old .strip()-first predicate would have over-flagged a leading-whitespace 'import' line that real CPython does not execute either. Repaired J-2 by changing _current_agent_identity() in hatp_class_b_topology_verifier.py to return frozenset(os.getgroups()) | {os.getegid()} -- a set union independently folding in the effective gid, deduplicating naturally where the two already agree, with os.geteuid() (not os.getgid()) still used for the uid element. Repaired J-3 by adding a new _resolve_trusted_executable_with_effective_access(name) wrapper in hatp_class_b_topology_verifier.py that composes the unchanged, non-recursive PATH-precedence _resolve_trusted_executable with the same ACL-inclusive _effective_write_access/_ancestor_chain_safe primitives already used for Protected Root (HBDC-REQ-016/017) -- covering both Git-executable and Git-ancestor ACL grants, failing closed on ACL-inspection indeterminacy, with no ACL-tool-resolution recursion introduced (the base primitive stays byte-unchanged since getfacl/ls resolution inside the ACL branch always routes through it, never through the new wrapper); hatp_environment_lock_verifier.py's _check_trusted_git() now calls this wrapper. hatp_class_b_conformance.py required no change and is confirmed byte-unchanged. Existing 20I test suites (98 tests across topology/environment-lock/conformance): 98/98 passed, zero regressions. Frozen 20J independent-verification suite (63 tests): 61 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing, unrelated), 1 disclosed and expected regression -- test_agent_effective_gid_not_in_getgroups_can_be_missed, a source-absence finding-confirmation test (not a live-code security assertion) whose own docstring instructs 'if this assertion now fails, the gap has been closed and this test should be updated'; left unmodified per historical-defect-snapshot preservation, fully reconstructable via git history at 149O.20J's own commits (fa5f54af, cfd93180). The other two finding-tests in that same frozen suite continue to pass unmodified by design: one asserts against an inlined copy of the pre-repair predicate (not live production code), the other asserts _resolve_trusted_executable's own source remains ACL-unaware, which the repair deliberately preserves. Wrote a new independent repair-verification suite, tests/test_phase_149o_20j_1_class_b_deployment_verifier_narrow_defect_repair.py (26 tests): 26/26 passed, targeting exactly J-1/J-2/J-3 with positive security assertions against the live repaired production functions (never inlined pre-repair logic), plus cross-cutting regression guards (read-only AST scan across all three modules, zero-parameter public API signatures, real-host non-COMPLIANT result, aggregator byte-unchanged-since-HEAD, anti-recursion proof via a self-poisoning monkeypatch). Broad sweep (pytest -k 'class_b or hbdc or hmic or 149o_20', pre-existing fido2-import collection error ignored): net delta versus phase-entry baseline (git stash -u) of +8 failed/+18 passed -- 7 of the 8 are pre-existing 'no dirty src/pcae/ working tree' snapshot tests belonging to unrelated historical phases (149O.19.4, 20a, 20c, 20d, 20d.1, 20e, 20h), independently confirmed via source inspection to check git diff HEAD (not a frozen historical diff) and therefore inherently, transiently tripped by this phase's own uncommitted production edits; re-ran all 10 of the fast_green superset of these post-commit and confirmed all 10 pass again once the working tree is clean. The 8th new failure is the single disclosed regression above. Fast Green: phase-entry baseline (git stash -u, deselecting the pre-existing fido2 collection-error module) 69 failed/6720 passed/5 skipped/1 error; raw with-changes run 80 failed/6735 passed/5 skipped/1 error (net +11 failed -- the same 10 dirty-tree checks, a fast_green superset of the broad sweep's 7, plus the 1 disclosed regression -- /+15 passed); clean-deselected citation (post-commit, deselecting the exact raw-run failing node IDs plus the already-disclosed test_backend_cli.py parallel-execution flakiness, via an argv-list subprocess call not shell string interpolation): 0 failed, 6744 passed, 5 skipped, 1 pre-existing fido2 collection error. Real-host result unchanged after repair: NOT_COMPLIANT on the unprovisioned dev host, zero mutation observed (before/after git status, .pcae/ snapshot, environment). Zero production authority consumers of the three verifier modules reconfirmed repository-wide after repair. Created a governed implementation-mode task naming exactly the repaired files, the new test file, the phase document, and PROJECT_STATUS.md/CHANGELOG.md/task-lifecycle files as allowed, before making any change. Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20J_1_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_VERIFIER_NARROW_DEFECT_REPAIR.md documenting the baseline, historical reproduction, all three repairs with CPython-grammar and no-recursion-trap rationale, full regression results, HBDC/CBD/attack-matrix/self-caught-defect regression, real-host result, zero-consumer/HMIC-non-binding reconfirmation, CBV-S1/CBV-S10 status, and the repair verdict. Updated PROJECT_STATUS.md (demoting 149O.20J to a new stacked 'Previous Phase' entry) and CHANGELOG.md. Committed as 0f2bb93c. Verdict: CLASS-B VERIFIER NARROW DEFECT REPAIR -- IMPLEMENTED, 3/3 BLOCKING FINDINGS REPAIRED, INDEPENDENT RE-VERIFICATION PENDING, VERIFIER REMAINS NON-AUTHORITATIVE, SOURCE REMAINS OUTSIDE HMIC, POSITIVE CONSUMPTION REMAINS FORBIDDEN. J-1/J-2/J-3 exit status: REPAIRED -- INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PENDING (not CLOSED). CBV-S1: REPAIR IMPLEMENTED -- INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION REQUIRED -- HMIC SOURCE-SCOPE BINDING STILL PENDING -- NOT CLOSED. CBV-S10: unchanged, still NOT CLOSED. Class-B remains CONTRACT VERIFIED -- VERIFIER REPAIRED NON-AUTHORITATIVELY -- NOT PROVISIONED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. This phase does not authorize real provisioning, certification, activation, HMIC scope evolution, or readiness integration.
